_comment: Civics (scripts/civics.gd): standing choices with a price, Paradox style. Ship's articles live in the crew screen, a held town's laws in its base screen. Each slot holds one option; its default has no effects. A slot can change once every change_days. Pirate crews vote on new articles: benefit (-1..1) is how much the change favours them, against what it replaces. bonus keys: morale (crew), unrest (x on hands joining a ringleader), desertion (x on desertion in port), wages (x on crew wages), enemy_morale and merchant_morale (the enemy's at the start of a battle), honour_per_battle and fear_per_battle, loyalty (a town's), order (a town's streets, as in port life), tax (x on a town's taxes), rebels (x on the size of a rising). laws: set on the town's live laws while in force. relations: a one-off change of standing when adopted.

discipline.name: Discipline
discipline.description: How the ship keeps order between the captain's orders and the crew's tempers.

quarter.name: Quarter
quarter.description: What happens to a ship that fights you and loses.

maimed.name: The maimed
maimed.description: What a hand is owed for an arm or a leg lost in the ship's service.

rule.name: Rule
rule.description: Who keeps the peace in the streets, and how.

harbour.name: Harbour
harbour.description: Who may anchor here, and what they pay.

ship_law.name: The articles' law
ship_law.description: Moses' law for theft, marooning for desertion, and nothing for the rest. What every crew expects.

the_lash.name: The lash
the_lash.description: A flogging for any slackness. The crew hate it, and nobody dares listen to a ringleader.

easy_ship.name: An easy ship
easy_ship.description: Cards, rum and no floggings. A happy ship and an idle one: any loudmouth finds listeners.

give_quarter.name: Quarter given
give_quarter.description: Strike your colours and you'll be spared. The custom of the sea.

no_quarter.name: No quarter
no_quarter.description: Fight us and nobody lives. Crews strike sooner rather than face it, and the whole Caribbean hears of every fight.

fair_dealing.name: Fair dealing
fair_dealing.description: Prisoners fed and set ashore at the next port, nobody tortured for the strongbox. Merchants know it and strike sooner; feeding them costs.

own_risk.name: At their own risk
own_risk.description: A hand who loses a limb gets the crew's pity and a berth as cook, if there's one free.

maimed_fund.name: A fund for the maimed
maimed_fund.description: Six hundred pieces of eight for a right arm, out of the common chest before any shares. Dear, and hands stay.

old_customs.name: The old customs
old_customs.description: The town's own constables and courts, answering to you.

martial_law.name: Martial law
martial_law.description: Patrols, a curfew and a gallows in the square. Quiet streets, sullen people, and trade suffers.

town_council.name: A council of townsmen
town_council.description: The merchants and planters run the town's affairs in your name, and keep a little of the taxes for their trouble.

brethren_welcome.name: The Brethren welcome
brethren_welcome.description: Any pirate may drop anchor and spend their gold. The streets are rough for it.

free_port.name: A free port
free_port.description: Light harbour dues and no questions asked. Traders crowd in, and so does everyone else.

closed_to_pirates.name: Closed to the Brethren
closed_to_pirates.description: Respectable ships only. The townsfolk sleep easier; the Brethren call you a traitor.
